reviews.comment: The lectures were boring in both class and lab. The labs are basically another lecture. There's a group project in lab. The exams were kind of difficult, but doable.

The lecture and lab are not that bad. The lab case study project is not that hard and if you ask questions, you'll get plenty of help. I would recommend going to exam review sessions to make sure you understand key points that will be on the exam and he is very helpful during these review sessions. I will warn that the lab is very math heavy.

Dr. Carstens was a great lecturer! He records class, tells you "key points" for the exam, hosts review sessions for every exam, and goes over the answers afterward. Lab quizzes are exactly like the review, HW is a bit tedious but given two attempts. He's super nice and wants you to succeed. The required readings were hardly tested.

Unlike others, I really enjoyed this class and Carstens is very caring and responsive. Lecture/lab get really boring. Study early for tests and go over main lecture concepts. There's a lot of free response on exams so fully understand material. Lab is simple math and lab quizzes help your grade! He gives lots of extra credit, so take it!

I really disliked this class and his teaching style, every lecture he just read slides with so much info to memorize. Exams are LONG and not easy you have to know a lot of material and be able to apply it. The amount of work for lab is ridiculous IMO: a HW due every week, case study project, and lab quizzes. He gave 55 EC pts though which was nice.

The lab for this class was horrendous. Almost always took the entire time, lots of homework every week, and very little interactive activities. The lecture is straight forward, study slides and class notes and you will be fine. Lab quizzes are similar to the reviews, so attend review sessions. Good luck on the lab case study, it was a pain.

Very approachable and friendly guy. His lectures are just powerpoint slides, but study ahead of time because exams hold lots of content. Exams are very memorization heavy - you really need to know your stuff for the free-response section especially. Lab section is more math-heavy and lecture is more conceptual. NOT a slack-off class.

This guy does a standard job at presenting, and class is not too difficult if you carried knowledge over from nutrition. Lectures were fine and all nessessary information was presented in them. Lots of material, but most MC questions on exam can be solved through intuition alone. Short-answer section was kind of hard though.

Dr. Carstens was an ok prof. His lectures were very boring, but everything on the tests came from the 318 lecture book. He gave fair tests and posted the zoom exam reviews. Lecture portion was all memorization. Lab very long and drug out. Lab homework helped my grade. Study for lab quizzes, questions were very similar to homework and lab examples.

Carstens is a pretty typical professor. His class is not too bad, but it can be a little boring. He got political a few times, which didn't seem appropriate but whatever. Most assignments are graded by the TAs, but he's available for questions. Also gave out review sheets for exams. Optional final if you had less than 2 absences.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Carstens' class was hard but not impossible, especially if you use quizlet to study for the tests, and try to understand the big picture of the content bc it makes the class so much easier! BUT I will say he got political a few times which I thought was kinda unprofessional. Also, lab is super math heavy so be prepared to study for lab quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Be ready for short time limits on exams! Really study the recorded lectures! I made the mistake of focusing too much on the lab work; it doesn't count nearly as much as lecture exams. Don't miss any attendance quizzes if you can help it!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Carstens genuinely cares about his students and encourages people to email or even call him for help. The material is difficult, but it's important and useful in the animal science field. Sometimes it was hard to pay attention in lecture because it becomes a little monotonous, but if you study outside of class you can easily succeed.

Dr. Carstens lectures can be really boring, but I found the material interesting. He really does care about the students and is willing to discuss the material one-on-one. STUDY THE OLD EXAMS but study the lecture notes for the short answer section. The lab has homework every week and wasn't a favorite. Attendance is mandatory.

Dr. Carstens is stuck in his ways of teaching and unwilling to acknowledge an answer as correct if it's not exactly what he is looking for. I took the summer course (M-F) and he jammed the entire semester into 4 weeks, often times just flipping through slides & not talking it over. Find the old exam bible. Studying : 60% old exams & 40% lecture.

This class is definitely hard. I did not like the way Carstens tought the material. It's difficult to understand him sometimes, so you have to sit in the front. It was ALOT of material for each exam. The lab itself was kinda difficult depending on your TA. Exams are about half mc and half short answer. The material is really dry.

Dr. Carstens is a decent professor. 318 is hard so go to class everyday. Buy the lecture notes! They rarely change each semester so try to find a used packet. Dr. Carstens is a very serious lecturer, however he is willing to help you in and outside of class. Most of his test questions are recycled from old ones, but don't rely on them completely.

The best way to study for his test is to take the practice tests online and to get old exams. Many questions are word for word the same as old exams. Attendance is mandatory if you don't want to take the final; not only do you have to take the final, but your exam grades are also averaged. Old exams can be hard to come by!
